text:
karim: PSA  planning a targeted least-privilege sweep for data-platform svc accounts next week. owners will get a notification. please don't action until we finalize exemptions.

sylvia: thanks. quick Q: do we have reliable requestor/ticket metadata on KMS grants? last sweep flagged several with NULL requestor.

lee: short answer: not consistently. webhook timeouts during the 03/22 deploy left gaps. i'm working on making the webhook idempotent + persisting `deploy_tag` and `incident_id`. infra ticket #3187.

noah: can we add a safe-exclude rule so the prune job skips grants with `deploy_tag` or `incident_id` present? we had a false demotion last month.

access-bot: Automation notice: entitlement-prune "data-svc-pass" scheduled 2026-04-12T04:00Z. Current grace_days=7. To request change, open PR infra/tools/admin-prune.

karim: propose: (1) extend grace_days to 14 for this pass, (2) exclude grants where `metadata->>'incident_id' IS NOT NULL OR metadata->>'deploy_tag' IS NOT NULL`, (3) backfill audit payloads from s3 for any missing requestor fields before pruning.

sylvia: +1. i'll run a query to produce a tentative whitelist and mark which grants are missing audit metadata. sample: 
```
SELECT g.grant_id, g.principal, g.created_at, g.requestor
FROM kms_grants g
LEFT JOIN audit_events e ON e.grant_id = g.grant_id
WHERE g.principal LIKE 'svc-data-%'
  AND g.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '45 days';
```

lee: i'll hand off a small backfill job to pull webhook payloads from s3 prefix `audit-webhooks/2026/03/22/` and patch kms_grants where possible. any unmatched grants will be tagged `audit_gap=true` and exempt for 30 days.

noah: i'll own the whitelist and the owner comms. plan: post CSV with `grant_id,principal,created_at,origin,audit_gap` by Tue noon.

karim: also: add a column to the review sheet for `temporary_elevation` and provide guidance: owners should mark Y if elevation ties to an open incident ticket. that will prevent automation from demoting.

access-bot: Action logged: change request to grace_days=14 (pending PR), exemption rule for `incident_id`/`deploy_tag`, and pause window until backfill completes. To pause automation add label `hold-data-pass` to infra PR.

sylvia: minor vuln note: vuln scanner flagged a service dependency used by svc-data-ingest. if we demote the service account before rotating the key, it may break remediation scripts. let's coordinate vuln fix and rotation pre-demote.

karim: good catch. noah, include remediations status in the CSV so we don't demote accounts mid-rotation.

noah: will do. final plan: lee backfill + tag audit_gap, noah whitelist + remediations, karim open PR to change grace_days, sylvia monitor vuln tracker. hold prune until we confirm.

access-bot: Acknowledged. Automation paused for label `hold-data-pass`. Resume by commenting `resume data-svc-pass`.

lee: I'll post infra#3187 link with ETA for webhook fixes and the backfill results by EOD tomorrow.

karim: thanks all. ping here if anyone sees unexpected KMS churn during the window and we'll hold the run. :hand:
